title: Model Makers, Metal and Plastic
description: Set up and operate machines, such as lathes, milling and engraving machines, and jig borers to make working models of metal or plastic objects. Includes template makers.

tasks.text: Study blueprints, drawings, and sketches to determine material dimensions, required equipment, and operations sequences.
tasks.rationale: information retrieval — Parse specs and materials from orders

dwas.name: Read work orders or other instructions to determine product specifications or materials requirements.
Review blueprints or other instructions to determine operational methods or sequences.

tasks.text: Set up and operate machines, such as lathes, drill presses, punch presses, or bandsaws, to fabricate prototypes or models.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Metal and plastic forming equipment run by hand

dwas.name: Operate metal or plastic forming equipment.
Operate cutting equipment.

tasks.text: Program computer numerical control (CNC) machines to fabricate model parts.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Programming production equipment needs physical setup and verification

dwas.name: Program equipment to perform production tasks.

tasks.text: Inspect and test products to verify conformance to specifications, using precision measuring instruments or circuit testers.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Material product inspection is physical and sensory

dwas.name: Inspect metal, plastic, or composite products.

tasks.text: Cut, shape, and form metal parts, using lathes, power saws, snips, power brakes and shears, files, and mallets.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on industrial material cutting

dwas.name: Shape metal workpieces with hammers or other small hand tools.
Cut industrial materials in preparation for fabrication or processing.

tasks.text: Rework or alter component model or parts as required to ensure that products meet standards.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical disassembly and reassembly of parts

dwas.name: Repair parts or assemblies.

tasks.text: Drill, countersink, and ream holes in parts and assemblies for bolts, screws, and other fasteners, using power tools.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Drilling parts requires physical tool operation

dwas.name: Drill holes in parts, equipment, or materials.

tasks.text: Grind, file, and sand parts to finished dimensions.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Grinding requires hands-on control and feel

dwas.name: Smooth metal surfaces or edges.
Operate grinding equipment.

tasks.text: Devise and construct tools, dies, molds, jigs, and fixtures, or modify existing tools and equipment.
tasks.rationale: decision support — AI drafts tooling; machinist and engineer verify

dwas.name: Assemble machine tools, parts, or fixtures.
Build production molds.
Design tools, fixtures, or other devices for production equipment.
dwas.gwa_name: Drafting, Laying Out, and Specifying Technical Devices, Parts, and Equipment

tasks.text: Record specifications, production operations, and final dimensions of models for use in establishing operating standards and procedures.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Record production data into structured logs

dwas.name: Record operational or production data.

tasks.text: Align, fit, and join parts, using bolts and screws or by welding or gluing.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Aligning parts for assembly needs hands and judgment

dwas.name: Assemble metal or plastic parts or products.
Align parts or workpieces to ensure proper assembly.

tasks.text: Lay out and mark reference points and dimensions on materials, using measuring instruments and drawing or scribing tools.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Drawing guide lines on materials is hands-on

dwas.name: Draw guide lines or markings on materials or workpieces using patterns or other references.

tasks.text: Consult and confer with engineering personnel to discuss developmental problems and to recommend product modifications.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Diagnosis support good; physical resolution needs humans

dwas.name: Confer with others to resolve production problems or equipment malfunctions.
dwas.gwa_name: Coordinating the Work and Activities of Others

tasks.text: Use computer-aided design (CAD) and computer-aided manufacturing (CAM) software or hardware to fabricate model parts.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Programming production equipment needs physical setup and verification

dwas.name: Program equipment to perform production tasks.

tasks.text: Assemble mechanical, electrical, and electronic components into models or prototypes, using hand tools, power tools, and fabricating machines.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on assembly of metal or plastic parts

dwas.name: Assemble metal or plastic parts or products.

tasks.text: Wire and solder electrical and electronic connections and components.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Soldering requires fine manual dexterity

dwas.name: Solder parts or workpieces.
